title: Four-bar windshield-wiper task suite
goal: Verify the approved windshield sweep and return-to-home behavior from one four-bar linkage roundtrip.

scenarios.title: Sweep and return the wiper
execution_requirements: Execute the sweep and return checks from one continuous output-angle roundtrip.
Measure output-rocker angle from the authored wiper output frame in both required branches.

tasks.title: Sweep the windshield
tasks.goal: Produce at least the approved wiper sweep angle.

criteria.description: The output wiper sweep reaches at least 26 degrees.

failure_diagnostics.description: The measured output sweep is less than 26 degrees.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the physical and ideal-reference output-angle traces and the evaluated sweep amplitude.

tasks.title: Return the wiper home
tasks.goal: Return the wiper to its initial position within the approved error.

criteria.description: The final wiper home error is at most 3.5 degrees.

failure_diagnostics.description: The final output-rocker angle is more than 3.5 degrees from its initial position.

evidence_obligations: Preserve the final physical and ideal-reference output angles and the return-to-start evaluation.

source_projects.note: Both typed task criteria were historically executed and passed with physical and ideal-reference evidence.

approval.basis: The user approved retaining the existing 26 degree sweep and 3.5 degree return criteria as one grouped machine task suite.
